card.name: Spots where a dose measure may come next
card.fires_on: Scattered words in the middle of a phrase where a unit or measure word could come next, such as 'mg-per-mg', 'ANTIGEN E CONCENTRATION' and 'HANG THE BAG'. The firing words are very mixed.

modes.label: Dose-equivalence phrases
modes.description: Hyphenated linking words in 'mg-to-mg' or 'mg-per-mg' basis wording.

modes.label: Capitalised label headings and warnings
modes.description: Words inside all-caps instructions or headings about bags, routes or treatment.

card.writes: It pushes the word 'unit' and its translations as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on mixed spots where a word like 'unit' might plausibly come next, most clearly in 'mg-to-mg' wording.
